releases.summary: A larger, sharper look on the Mac, and a fix for the Master Transport.

changes.text: Clicking around in a playing cue's waveform in the Master Transport no longer drops the cue from the transport and the cue list's playing indicator while it keeps playing.
Mac: SFX 7 is drawn at the Mac's own size, so text and controls are about 30% larger, as in other Mac apps.
Mac: Media, Remote, History, Network, Preferences and Diagnostics no longer show a back arrow that led to a list with no way back to the show.

releases.summary: The license agreement, a clearer way to quit, and fixes for the Mac.

changes.text: The license agreement is shown the first time SFX 7 opens (and on the Windows installer's license page), and any time in File > License Agreement.
Quitting asks whether to save the show first, then whether to stop the show engine.
The main window opens on most of the screen the first time and remembers where it was. In a narrow window, the side panels move under the cue list as tabs.
The docked Master Transport shows beside the cue list. A long cue name could leave it no room.
License keys pasted with extra spaces or other dash characters are accepted.
Mac: shows open in the downloaded app, and Quit finishes the first time.

releases.summary: The first release of SFX 7: sound, video and show control for theatre and live events, on Windows and Mac.

changes.text: One cue list, one GO: sound, video and show-control cues with waits, autofollows, fades and the Master Transport.
Design mode to build the show and Play mode to run it.
Patch your sound card's outputs into busses, with a matrix, and play live inputs in Live Audio cues.
Fire cues from a lighting desk, show controller or button box with OSC, MIDI and MIDI Show Control.
Panels can be docked or opened in their own windows, on Windows and Mac (Apple silicon and Intel).
Free 7-day trial, weekly rental or purchase. Activation needs the internet once, then SFX 7 runs offline.
